title: Carriers
description: Invite carriers, manage their links and share a public booking link per site.

invite.title: Invite a carrier
invite.description: The carrier gets an email with a link that works for 7 days. Booking is free for carriers.

linked.empty: Invite a carrier by email, or switch on a public link so carriers can register.
linked.deactivate_description: {{name}} can no longer book new slots. Existing bookings stay visible to both sides.
linked.deactivated: {{name}} can no longer book new slots.

registrations.empty: Carriers who register through a public link appear here.
registrations.reject_description: The carrier receives this reason by email.

links.regenerate_description: The current link stops working at once. Share the new one with your carriers.
links.hint: A link answers only while it is switched on for its site. Switch links on and choose automatic or manual approval in Settings.
links.empty: Create a site first. Each site gets its own public link.

tenants.title: Warehouses
tenants.description: The warehouses where your company books slots.
tenants.empty: A warehouse invites you by email or shares its public booking link.
tenants.name: Warehouse
tenants.pending: {{name}} reviews your registration. You can book there once it is approved.

accept.title: Join as a carrier
accept.summary: {{tenant}} invites {{company}} to book slots on rampflow.

accept.name: Your name
accept.sign_in_first: This email already has an account. Sign in to accept. The warehouse is linked to your company.
